text_block_list.text:
Some time after signing my contract with Sounds of Earth.
I was devising a strategy for the upcoming mock race.

Judging by the other contenders' training, it looks like it'll be
a chaotic race. How should we approach it—
choice_data_list: There are a lot of closers, so maybe run as a leader?
There are a lot of closers, so maybe run as a leader?

text_block_list.text:
If she takes a good position near the front, she could hold off
the chasing pack and stay ahead for the win.

However, some of them have sharp late kicks. Would playing it safe
from mid-pack with her signature betweener style be best? Hard to say...
choice_data_list: (Wait... why is she playing the violin...?! )

text_block_list.text:
After suddenly starting to play for some reason, Sounds of Earth
finishes her piece and gives a graceful bow to a bewildered me.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: How was that performance? Would you share your impressions?
choice_data_list: It felt... kind of wild and intense, maybe?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Grazie!
An abbandono response! That is what resonated in your heart!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Yet, is that all?
Surely something else was born within you.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —So, why not play an answer song with this?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Have no fear. Just as you heard it, just as you felt it...
Surrender yourself to the notes drifting across your heart's staff.

I stare down at the maracas handed to me.
I have no idea what she's getting at, but—
choice_data_list: (For now, let's just give them a shake...)

text_block_list.text:
An answer song, huh... Playing something identical would be dull.
So I start quietly, at a tempo that's the polar opposite of intense.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Hm... Bene! One cannot remain at a fermata forever!
Allow me to join in!

Keeping the same tempo throughout might bore Sounds of Earth.
Since this is an answer song to a passionate piece, here I go—
(Chaka-chaka! Chaka-chaka!!)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: I see, right here...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Building up tension only to unleash it all at once!
Splendid, the time has come to release everything! Esplosione!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Bravo! What a magnificent session!
This answer song is bene!
choice_data_list: Thanks. But why did we do this?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Brava! What a magnificent session that was!
This answer song is bene!
choice_data_list: Thanks. But why did you have me do that?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I simply wished to hear the answer residing within you.
And I received it loud and clear!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
You needn't worry about the upcoming mock race at all.
Just look forward to our next session!

The day of the mock race arrived.
Sounds of Earth told me not to worry, and yet—

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Right from the start, a fierce battle unfolds for the lead!
Meanwhile, Sounds of Earth and a few others bide their time near the back!

She seems content to run at her own pace in the early phase.
Is she sticking to her own tempo without letting the crowd dictate her rhythm?

As they hit the middle phase, the gap between the lead pack and the rear widens.
The frontrunners appear to be picking up the pace!
choice_data_list: Earth, are you not going to make a move yet...?
Earth, aren't you going to make a move yet...?

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
The race enters its final stretch! Fatigue seems to be setting in among the frontrunners!
Wait! Blasting forward from behind with unbelievable momentum is—

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Sounds of Earth! Here comes Sounds of Earth!
It's as if she's unleashing all the power she's been saving up in one explosive surge!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Taaaahhhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
She crosses the line! 1st place goes to Sounds of Earth!
With a thrilling late charge, she takes a brilliant victory!

Quiet in the opening, surging into an explosive climax.
It unfolded just like that answer song from before... Don't tell me—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I have returned, Trainer.
How did you find today's session?
choice_data_list: Your running was just like that performance from the other day.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you noticed?
I reproduced that piece of music to absolute perfection, did I not?
choice_data_list: But why did you have me play back then?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Because you were exuding confusione.
So I wanted you to wave your baton just as your heart desired!

Indeed, the initial performance she had shared with me
had been turbulent and intense, mirroring the race alongside the other horsegirls.

To express our strategy through musical performance and run it precisely that way...
I could only take my hat off to her artistic genius.

My resolve to become a Trainer worthy of her grew even stronger.
If I learned more about the music she loves, would I be able to understand her better?
